image_description: A close-up, underwater photograph showing the head and rostrum of a large cetacean. The skin is dark grey with distinctive lighter patches and raised bumps (callosities/barnacles). The mouth line is visible, curving upwards. The background is murky green water.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin clearly exhibits the characteristic mottled grey coloration and scattered white/greyish callosities typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal region is not visible in this head-focused crop.
